message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, driven by growth in commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government [D1]. Total segment revenue reached $1,846 million representing a 36.54 percent increase from the prior year due to strong performance in both reportable segments [D1]. Operating income for the Communications Solutions Group increased to $458 million from $246 million last year as gross margin expanded to 70.97 percent [D1].
